abstraction_design.rationale: The card/table/badge abstractions are the right ones for the real variation, but there is no shared detail-page or list-page abstraction, so similar pages are copies and cross-page behavior means N edits.

findings.issue: Every page consumes its payload as useFetch<any>, so the typed exports in server/utils/pokeapi.ts:11-34 never cross the server/client seam; refactoring payload shapes is invisible to the compiler.
findings.suggestion: Move shared response types to a shared/types (or #shared) directory and type each useFetch call with them.

findings.issue: Single 490-line module mixes transport, cache, formatting helpers, index building and four page-data builders; new entities make it grow monotonically.
findings.suggestion: Split into pokeapi/http (apiGet + cache), pokeapi/format (humanize, englishName, flavor), pokeapi/index and one page-data file per entity.

findings.issue: The param-name computed, reactive useFetch URL, notFound handling and useHead title ternary are duplicated across four detail pages, so any change to that boilerplate is a four-file edit.
findings.suggestion: Extract a composable, e.g. useEntityPageData(pathFromName) that returns {data, title}, or use createErrorHandler-style shared wiring.

findings.issue: Sprite URLs are constructed from the ID pattern rather than read from API data, which is exactly the assumption behind the Deoxys-style sprite bug; the fallback branch at pokeapi.ts:229 also derives speciesName from a Pokémon ref name.
findings.suggestion: Prefer the API-provided front_default sprite for the default Pokémon (fetched during index build), keeping the pattern as a fallback in one place.

findings.issue: Prop shape {name,label} mismatches the server's {name,english}, forcing inline object reshaping at four call sites.
findings.suggestion: Rename the prop field to english (or accept the index TypeInfo directly) so call sites pass data through.

findings.issue: formatValue ('—' for missing) duplicated with app/pages/moves/[name].vue:54-56; dex-number padStart duplicated between components/PokemonCard.vue:7 and pages/pokemon/[name].vue:17.
findings.suggestion: Put formatValue/dexNumber in app/utils/format.ts (auto-imported) and use from both components.

findings.issue: The hidden-ability text is a card prop used only by the abilities page; removing Abilities strands a dead prop and the .hidden-ability rule (assets/css/main.css:238).
findings.suggestion: Use a slot or an ability-specific wrapper so the generic card carries no ability knowledge.

findings.issue: Manual query-string building (searchString/pageUrl) reimplements what router.resolve/withQuery already provide and is easy to get subtly wrong.
findings.suggestion: Use router.resolve({path:'/', query}) or NuxtLink's query prop instead of hand-concatenating encoded params.

findings.location: app/nuxt.config.ts:1 with app/ layout at repo app root
findings.issue: Runs on Nuxt 4.6.3 with the v3-style root layout (app.vue, pages/, components/ at project root), which Nuxt 4 supports only via its structure-detection fallback; the documented v4 default is a nested app/ directory.
findings.suggestion: Move app.vue/pages/components/assets/composables under app/app/ (the v4 srcDir), or accept the fallback deliberately with a comment.

summary: The data layer is the strong point: one module owns the API base URL, cache and every card derivation, so a sprite or data-source change lands in one place and covers all four card lists. Weaknesses cluster on the client: payloads are any-typed across the server seam, and each detail page hand-copies the same fetch/not-found/title boilerplate, so cross-page behavior changes mean N edits. Net: easy to fix and re-source, moderately more work to extend with new entity pages.
